audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 8.5/10 and report[14].t 'Hard matchup' against a 51.26% Renekton win rate over 4631 games, while diff itself says EVEN.
audit.why: This is one of the largest samples in the champion and Renekton is ahead in it. A 8.5/10 rating tells the player to avoid a lane the data says he wins slightly.
audit.corrected: diffRating 5.5/10 with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t reworded to match the EVEN enum. carryRating left at 8.5/10 — his item scaling genuinely carries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the packet chart — most importantly Level 6, which the page gave to Lucian while its own whys[4] says Dominus absorbs his burst and 'your solo-kill window is here'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Skill / Lucian / Lucian / Renekton / Renekton / Skill / Skill, and the mirror flipped exactly those four rows. whys[0] already calls Level 1 'pure mechanics' and whys[3] describes the levels 4-5 takeover.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings raised, phases[6].why rewritten, and whys[6] reworded so the two-item row reads as contested rather than lost.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page describes a slow on Piercing Light that does not exist, and never mentions that Renekton's own stun powers up Lightslinger.
audit.why: Riot's text for Q is one line — 'Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target' — no slow, 500 range, 9s at rank 1. And the passive: when a nearby enemy champion is IMMOBILIZED, his next 2 basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Renekton's own W stun triggers that, so a wasted 0.75s stun at under 50 Fury actively arms him. The 1.5s empowered version is long enough that the trade ends inside it. Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s but Lightslinger attacks REDUCE that cooldown, so it is not a fixed timer to count down.
audit.corrected: The phantom Q slow removed from whys[2] and early; the immobilize-arms-Lightslinger interaction written into wants.foe[1], dontsFull[0].d and wants.you[0]; the cooldown-reduction behaviour into dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Trade at zero fury' was listed as a mistake with no explanation of why it is worse here than anywhere else.
audit.why: Against Lucian specifically it is doubly punishing: the unempowered stun is short enough for him to dash out of and it hands his passive two bonus-damage autos.

edits.after: Feed Lightslinger — every ability doubles his next shot, and your own W stun arms two bonus-damage autos

edits.before: Level 1 is a genuine coin flip — Lucian's passive double-shot gives him burst you cannot match before your E is online, so do not step up to auto-trade; last-hit at Q range and build Fury passively. At level 2 he is the stronger duelist: his E-dash lets him dodge your W animation, proc Lightslinger, and disengage before you can Q-heal. Accept the poke and save your first E to escape, not engage. Level 3 is still his window — his Q slow plus double-shot makes a full Lightslinger rotation hurt badly, and without 50 Fury your W is only a 0.75-second stun he can dash through. Farm clean, deny him free autos, and wait for level 4.
edits.after: Level 1 is a genuine coin flip — Lucian's passive double-shot gives him burst you cannot match before your E is online, so do not step up to auto-trade; last-hit at Q range and build Fury passively. At level 2 he is the stronger duelist: his E-dash lets him dodge your W animation, proc Lightslinger, and disengage before you can Q-heal. Accept the poke and save your first E to escape, not engage. Level 3 is still his window — Piercing Light pierces from 500 range for free, and without 50 Fury your W is only a 0.75-second stun that he dashes out of AND that arms his passive. Farm clean, deny him free autos, and wait for level 4.

notes: Biggest find here is not a wrong name, it is a missing interaction that inverts a piece of advice: Lightslinger gives Lucian two bonus-damage attacks whenever a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, so Renekton's own unempowered W stun powers up the return trade. That makes 'never trade at zero Fury' a mechanical rule in this matchup rather than a slogan. Second: Piercing Light has no slow — the page invented one in two places. Third: Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is reduced by his Lightslinger attacks, so 'count 16 seconds' is not a safe read. tone is the red #ff5d6c on a lane now rated 5.5/10 EVEN — I did not guess the EVEN palette value; see questionsForUser.
